fields.summary_ko.0: TSM rose 33.2% over the past year (semiconductor sector +6.8%), Q3 revenue increased 41.2% YoY to $4.672 billion, net profit up 68.7%, benefiting from accelerating AI infrastructure investments.
fields.summary_ko.1: TSMC's advanced technology (7 nanometers and below) represents 79% of wafer revenue, with 2 nanometers increasing from 3% to 8%, and capex for 2026–2028 projected to significantly exceed total capex for the three years through 2025.
